d: Ham ek aise samay men ji rahe hain jahan har chij ko aankron men badal diya jata hai. jindgi kitni hai, maut kitni huee aur kitni ummid bachi hai, sab kuchh sankhyaon men simat gaya hai. ek aisa daur hai jahan insan ki pahchan bhi kabhi-kabhi sirph ek sankhya bankar rah jati hai. in aankron ke bich insan ka dard, uski kahani aur uski aavaj aksar kahin kho jati hai. isi daur men ek kavi ne aisi rachnaen likhin jo hamen sochne par majbur karti hain aur hamari sanvednaon ko jhakjhor deti hain. ve the kunvar narayan. aaj sahity tak par Poetry On Loop ke is episod men sunie kunvar narayan ki…
